source:
@@U00341@@
I speak only the modest truth, sir.
And yet men,
that foolish congregation of petty microcosms,
insist on calling themselves whole entities.
As for me,
I’m a part of that Part that at first was All,
a part of the darkness that gave birth to light,
arrogant light that competes with Night
for her ancient rank and ancient space.
But it won't succeed, struggle as it may.
Light is one with objects.
Light flows from bodies,
it gives bodies beauty,
and yet bodies check it in its course.
And so, I trust, it won't be long
till light and the physical world
go down to dark destruction.

@@U00343@@
Yes, I begin to grasp it,
your worthy occupation!
Unable to annihilate wholesale,
you've made a stab at it retail.

@@U00345@@
Yes, and a lot of good it’s done me.
Empty hands is all I have.
This Something, this lump of a world, this mess,
for all the inroads I've made on it with my Nothing,
does nothing but oppose me tooth and nail.
What good have flood and fire,
earthquake and storms done me?
Nothing!
Land and sea are as unshaken as ever.
And as for that damnable brood of men and animals,
translation:
@@U00341@@
我只说最朴实的事实，先生。
然而男人们，
那一群愚蠢的小宇宙，
坚持称自己为完整的实体。
至于我，
我是最初是全部的一部分的一部分，
黑暗的一部分孕育出光明，
与黑夜竞争的傲慢之光
为了她古老的等级和古老的空间。
但它不会成功，尽管可能会挣扎。
光与物体合一。
光从身体流出，
它赋予身体美丽，
然而，机构却在其过程中对其进行检查。
所以，我相信，这不会太久
直到光和物质世界
走向黑暗的毁灭。

@@U00343@@
是的，我开始明白了，
你值得的职业！
无法消灭批发，
你已经尝试零售了。

@@U00345@@
是的，这对我有很多好处。
我两手空空。
这个东西，这个世界，这个混乱，
对于我用我的“Nothing”所取得的所有进展，
除了竭尽全力地反对我之外，什么也没做。
洪水和火灾有什么好处，
地震和风暴毁了我吗？
没有什么！
陆地和海洋一如既往地没有动摇。
